card.name: Guerrilla warfare in military history
card.fires_on: Words just before or inside a spot where 'guerrilla' or insurgent-force wording is expected, in history texts on Vietnam, Cuba and the Civil War. It fires on linking or describing words such as 'the', 'constant', 'small', 'daring' and on 'illa' in guerrilla.

modes.label: Inside guerrilla
modes.description: The ending of the word guerrilla while describing irregular warfare.

modes.description: Small words before names of insurgent or irregular forces in Vietnam War passages.
modes.example: government of South Vietnam,<< the>> Main Force and Local Force battalions

modes.label: Adjectives before raiding or small units
modes.description: Describing words before pressure, drives or small units acting independently.
modes.example: Federal forces stop Jackson's<< daring>> drive, but his campaign sounds alarm bells

card.writes: It nudges the model toward guerrilla-style wording (gu...) and toward ideas of going behind lines or bands of fighters.
card.plain: It lights up in war history when the text is about irregular fighters and guerrilla-style fighting.
